facts.claim: "Expected renewal rate 75.2% (vs. 75.5% a year earlier — company attributes the modest decline to mix)"
facts.dossier_location: VRSN.md §4, final sentence of the results paragraph
facts.source: VRSN 8-K Ex-99.1 Q1 2026 (accession 0001014473-26-000019) and Q2 2026 (accession 0001014473-26-000026) earnings releases — both searched in full
facts.source_value: The figure "75.2" does not appear in either release. The only renewal-rate disclosure in the Q2 2026 release states: "The final .com and .net renewal rate for the first quarter of 2026 was 76.3 percent compared to 75.5 percent for the same quarter of 2025." This is an INCREASE (76.3% vs 75.5%), for the finalized Q1 2026 rate — not a Q2 2026 'expected' rate, and not a decline.
facts.note: The claimed figure (75.2%) and the claimed direction (decline, attributed to mix) are both unsupported by the cited primary source; the actual, only disclosed renewal-rate data point in the same release is an increase (76.3% vs 75.5%) for a different period. CORRECT VALUE: final Q1 2026 .com/.net renewal rate = 76.3% (up from 75.5% in Q1 2025); Q2 2026's own rate is not yet finalized (45-day lag, per the company's own disclosure). DOSSIER LINE TO FIX (VRSN.md §4): replace "expected renewal rate 75.2% (vs. 75.5% a year earlier — company attributes the modest decline to mix, as more first-time (lower-rate) renewals enter the base)" with wording reflecting the actual disclosure above.
